title: A spawned isolate's `output` field is typed `string`, and not the carrier of the parent's sink.
text: `rule:security/isolate-output-is-captured` and `rule:security/capture-answers-the-carrier` give captured output the parent sink's carrier type: `Core\Html\Markup` under a request and `Cli\Text` everywhere else. The result shape at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/isolate.rs:593` types `output` as `string`, and the module doc at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/isolate.rs:81` still calls the field unsettled. Re-emitting that string escapes the captured bytes a second time. Closing this types the field from the sink in force, checks that a captured page echoes unchanged, and rewrites the module doc's paragraph.
